title: Grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida grafik, jadval va diagrammalarni aniq tasvirlab, tahlil qilib, xulosa chiqara olasiz: trend lug‘ati, raqamlarni solishtirish, taxminiy va aniq ifodalar, dalilga asoslangan xulosalar.

scenes.title: Grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda hisobot tuzilishini va executive summaryni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilida grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirishni o‘rganamiz — IELTS Academic Task 1 va ishdagi har qanday ma’lumot taqdimotining asosi: trend lug‘ati, solishtirish, taxmin va aniqlik, dalilga asoslangan xulosa. Dars oxirida grafikni professional inglizcha tasvirlab bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson four. Today we learn how to describe and interpret data in English: trends, comparisons, approximation and drawing conclusions.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun ingliz tilida ma’lumotlarni tasvirlash va izohlashni o‘rganamiz: trendlar, solishtirish, taxmin va aniqlik, hamda xulosa chiqarish.

scenes.title: Grafik turlari va umumiy tuzilma

examples.t: The line graph compares sales in three regions.
examples.uz: Chiziqli grafik uchta hududdagi sotuvlarni solishtiradi.

examples.t: Overall, sales rose steadily except in 2021.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, 2021-yildan tashqari sotuvlar barqaror o‘sdi.

scenes.say_native: Avval grafik turlarini bilib oling: chiziqli grafik vaqt bo‘yicha trendni ko‘rsatadi, ustun shakliy grafik toifalarni solishtiradi, doira grafik ulushlarni, jadval esa aniq raqamlarni. Ingliz tilidagi har qanday grafik tavsifning uch qadami bor. Birinchi qadam — umumiy tuzilma — “Overall, sales rose steadily except in 2021” — umuman olganda sotuvlar barqaror o‘sdi — overview doim oldin keladi. Ikkinchi qadam — asosiy xususiyatlarni ta’kidlash — eng katta o‘sish, eng katta tushish, eng yuqori nuqta. Uchinchi qadam — tafsilotlar va solishtiruv. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: har bir nuqtani sanab o‘tish — baholovchi overview’ni birinchi gapda kutadi. Eslab qoling: umumiydan xususiyga.
scenes.say: Know your charts: line for trends over time, bars for comparing categories, pie for proportions, tables for precise figures. Start with an overall sentence, then highlight key features.
scenes.say_uz: Grafiklaringizni taning: chiziqli grafik vaqt trendlari uchun, ustunli grafik toifalarni solishtirish uchun, doira grafik ulushlar uchun, jadval esa aniq raqamlar uchun. Umumiy gap bilan boshlang, keyin asosiy xususiyatlarni ajrating.

scenes.title: Trend so‘zlari 1: ko‘tarilish va tushish fe’llari
board: soared / surged — keskin ↑ ; plunged / plummeted — keskin ↓

examples.t: Profits rose from 2 to 3.4 million dollars.
examples.uz: Daromad 2 milliondan 3,4 million dollarga ko‘tarildi.

examples.t: Spending plummeted in the final quarter.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar oxirgi chorakda keskin tushib ketdi.

scenes.say_native: Trend fe’llarining ikki guruhi. Ko‘tarilish: “rose” — ko‘taril-di, “increased” — osh-di, “climbed” — ko‘taril-di (sekinroq tuyuladi), “grew” — o‘s-di. Keskin ko‘tarilish: “soared” va “surged” — parvoz qildi, shiddatli oshdi — dramatik. Tushish: “fell” — tush-di, “decreased” — kamay-di, “dropped” — tushib ket-di, “declined” — pasay-di. Keskin tushish: “plunged” va “plummeted” — keskin quladi. IELTS’da har doim fe’lni sinonimlar bilan almashtiring — bir xil so‘z takrorlanmasin. Fe’lning otdoshi ham bor: “a rise in profit” — daromadning o‘sishi — “a dramatic fall in sales” — sotuvlardagi keskin pasayish. Eslab qoling: fe’l ham, ot ham ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Upward: rose, increased, climbed, grew, then soared and surged for a sharp rise. Downward: fell, decreased, dropped, declined, then plunged and plummeted for a sharp fall.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘tarilish: rose, increased, climbed, grew — keskin ko‘tarilish uchun esa soared va surged. Tushish: fell, decreased, dropped, declined — keskin tushish uchun esa plunged va plummeted.

scenes.title: Trend so‘zlari 2: darajali ravishlar, tekislik va tebranish
board: steadily / gradually / slightly / marginally — barqaror / sekin / biroz

examples.t: Exports rose steadily over the five-year period.
examples.uz: Eksport besh yillik davrda barqaror o‘sdi.

examples.t: The rate fluctuated between 4 and 7 per cent.
examples.uz: Ko‘rsatkich 4 va 7 foiz oralig‘ida tebranib turdi.

scenes.say_native: Trendning tezligi va darajasini ravishlar bildiradi. Keskin: “sharply” — keskin, “dramatically” — keskin, sezilarli, “steeply” — tik — “soared” bilan bog‘lanadi. Barqaror va sekin: “steadily” — barqaror, muntazam, “gradually” — asta-sekin, “slightly” — biroz, “marginally” — arzimas darajada. Tekislik: “remained stable” — barqaror qoldi, “plateaued” — bir tekisda to‘xtadi, “levelled off” — tekislanib to‘xtadi — o‘sishdan keyin turg‘unlik. Tebranish: “fluctuated” — tebranib turdi — “fluctuated between 4 and 7 per cent” — 4 va 7 foiz oralig‘ida. Eslab qoling: “rose slightly” va “slightly rose” — ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, lekin “rose sharp” xato — ravish “sharp” emas, “sharply”.
scenes.say: Adverbs of degree: sharply, dramatically, steeply for a steep change; steadily and gradually for a regular one; slightly and marginally for a small one. Flat: remained stable, plateaued. Unstable: fluctuated.
scenes.say_uz: Daraja ravishlari: sharply, dramatically, steeply — tik o‘zgarish uchun; steadily va gradually — muntazam o‘zgarish uchun; slightly va marginally — kichik o‘zgarish uchun. Tekis: remained stable, plateaued. Beqaror: fluctuated.

scenes.title: Trend fe’llarini tanlash mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyatga to‘g‘ri fe’l tanlang. Birinchi: 30 foizdan 45 foizga — sezilarli o‘sish — “rose sharply” yoki “soared”? Ikkinchi: 90 milliondan 40 millionga — keskin pasayish — “plummeted”. Uchinchi: 5 — 5,2 — 4,9 foiz — tebranish — “fluctuated”. Har bir holatda fe’l + ravish kombinatsiyasini ayting — “rose sharply”, “plummeted dramatically” kabi. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the right trend verb plus adverb: one, from thirty to forty-five per cent. Two, from ninety to forty million. Three, five, five point two, four point nine per cent.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri trend fe’l-ravish kombinatsiyasini tanlang: bir, o‘ttiz foizdan qirq besh foizga. Ikki, to‘qson milliondan qirq millionga. Uch, besh, besh butun o‘n va to‘rtdan to‘qqiz foiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar: trend tanlash
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Sales rose sharply from 30 to 45 per cent” — o‘n besh foiz band sezilarli — “surged” ham to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchi: “Revenue plummeted from 90 to 40 million” — “plunged” ham mumkin — keskin qulash. Uchinchi: “The rate fluctuated slightly around 5 per cent” — “fluctuated between 4.9 and 5.2 per cent” — to‘g‘riroq — tebranish. Diqqat qiling: raqam aniq bo‘lsa “approximately” qo‘shmang; tebranishda diapazon ayting.
scenes.say: Answers: sales rose sharply or surged; revenue plummeted or plunged; the rate fluctuated slightly. For fluctuations, give the range.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: sotuvlar keskin oshdi yoki surged bo‘ldi; daromad keskin tushdi yoki plunged bo‘ldi; ko‘rsatkich biroz tebrandi. Tebranishda diapazonni ayting.

scenes.title: Vaqt ifodalari va zamon: from X to Y, over the period

examples.t: Between 2020 and 2024, membership doubled.
examples.uz: 2020 va 2024-yillar orasida a’zolar soni ikki baravarga oshdi.

examples.t: Sales have risen steadily since 2021.
examples.uz: 2021-yildan beri sotuvlar barqaror o‘sdi.

scenes.say_native: Grafikdagi vaqtni ikki zamonda tasvirlaysiz. Tugagan o‘tmish davr — Past Simple: “Between 2020 and 2024, membership doubled” — 2020 va 2024 orasida a’zolar soni ikki barobarga oshdi — “rose from X to Y” — X dan Y gacha ko‘tarildi. Hali davom etayotgan davr — Present Perfect: “Sales have risen since 2021” — 2021-yildan beri sotuvlar o‘sdi — “since 2021” yoki “over the past three years” — oxirgi uch yilda. Foydali birikmalar: “over the period” — davr davomida, “in the first half of the year” — yilning birinchi yarmida, “by 2023” — 2023-yilga kelib — yetib bordi. Eslab qoling: “by 2023, sales had doubled” — dastlabki nuqtadan oldingi natija — Past Perfect — siz allaqachon bilasiz.
scenes.say: Use past simple for finished periods: between 2020 and 2024 membership doubled. Use present perfect with since: sales have risen since 2021. By 2023 marks a cumulative result.
scenes.say_uz: Tugagan davrlar uchun Past Simple: 2020–2024 orasida a’zolar soni ikki barobarga oshdi. Hali davom etayotgan davr uchun Present Perfect: 2021-yildan beri sotuvlar o‘sdi. By 2023 — umumiy natijani bildiradi.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni solishtirish: twice as much, half as many, compared to
board: twice as much / three times as many
half as much / half as many
compared to / compared with / whereas / while

examples.t: Sales in Tashkent were twice as high as in Samarkand.
examples.uz: Toshkentdagi sotuvlar Samarqandnikiga nisbatan ikki baravar yuqori edi.

examples.t: Online sales rose, whereas retail sales fell.
examples.uz: Onlayn sotuvlar oshdi, do‘kon sotuvlari esa pasaydi.

scenes.say_native: Solishtirishning inglizcha tuzilmalari aniq. Ko‘plikni taqqoslash: “twice as many / as much as” — ikki baravar ko‘p — “twice as high as” — ikki baravar yuqori — sanaladigan uchun “many”, sanalmaydigan yoki o‘lchov uchun “much”. Ko‘paytirish: “three times higher than” ham deyiladi, lekin “three times as high as” xavfsizroq variant. Kamaytirish: “half as much / half as many” — yarmi. Qarama-qarshi qo‘yish: “compared to / compared with” — bilan solishtirganda — “whereas” va “while” — esa — “Online sales rose, whereas retail fell” — jonli solishtirish. “In contrast” va “by comparison” — farqli ravishda. Eslab qoling: “twice more than” emas — bu deyarli uch baravar degan noto‘g‘ri anglashinuv beradi — har doim “twice as much as” deb ayting.
scenes.say: For comparing: twice as high as, three times as many as, half as much. For contrast: compared to, whereas, while, in contrast. Avoid the ambiguous twice more than.
scenes.say_uz: Solishtirish uchun: twice as high as, three times as many as, half as much. Farqni ko‘rsatish uchun: compared to, whereas, while, in contrast. Noaniq twice more than’dan qoching.

scenes.title: Solishtirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta solishtirishni ingliz tilida tuzing. Birinchi: 60 va 30 foiz — “twice as high as” ishlatib gap ayting. Ikkinchi: 400 va 800 — “half as many as” bilan. Uchinchi: tibbiyot 45, ta’lim 20 foiz — “whereas” bilan solishtiring. Har bir gap to‘liq bo‘lsin — “twice as high as” yoki “whereas” tuzilmasisiz qabul qilinmaydi. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Make three comparisons in English: one, sixty versus thirty per cent using twice as high as. Two, four hundred versus eight hundred using half as many as. Three, medical 45 %, education 20 % using whereas.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida uchta solishtirish tuzing: bir, oltmish va o‘ttiz foiz — twice as high as bilan. Ikki, to‘rt yuz va sakkiz yuz — half as many as bilan. Uch, tibbiyot 45 %, ta’lim 20 % — whereas bilan.

scenes.title: Javoblar: solishtirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “This figure was twice as high as that one — 60 % compared to 30 %” — aniq ikki baravar. Ikkinchi: “The figure for Tashkent was half as many as Fergana — 400 compared to 800” — yarmi. Uchinchi: “Medical spending stood at 45 %, whereas education was just 20 %” — “whereas” ikki qismni qarama-qarshiga qo‘yadi. Eslab qoling: solishtirishdan keyin raqamni qayta aytish — IELTS’da ball beradi.
scenes.say: Model answers: This figure was twice as high as that one. Tashkent recorded half as many as Fergana. Medical stood at 45 %, whereas education was just 20 %.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna javoblar: bu raqam anoviga nisbatan ikki baravar yuqori. Toshkent Farg‘onanikiga nisbatan yarmi. Tibbiyot 45 % edi, ta’lim esa atigi 20 %.

scenes.title: Grafik tavsifidagi odatiy xatolar

examples.t: The number of subscribers peaked at 1.2 million in 2022.
examples.uz: Obunachilar soni 2022-yilda 1,2 million bilan eng yuqori nuqtaga yetdi.

examples.t: The figure fell, but consumption remained steady.
examples.uz: Ko‘rsatkich pasaydi, lekin iste’mol barqaror qoldi.

scenes.say_native: Grafik tavsifidagi uchta odatiy xato. Birinchi: “The people increased” — odamlar o‘zi ko‘tarilmaydi — to‘g‘risi “The number of people rose” yoki “The figure for X rose” — “the number” yoki “the figure” raqamning ifodasi — odam emas. Ikkinchi: “more higher” va “most highest” — qiyosiy va orttirma ustama qilish xato — to‘g‘risi: “much higher”, “the highest” — yoki “far higher”. Uchinchi: “increased” deganidan keyin raqam aytmaslik — “Sales increased” — qanchaga? — har doim “by 15 %” yoki “to 45 %” bilan. Eslab qoling: “rose by + farq” va “rose to + yakuniy qiymat” — by va to’ni adashtirmang — “rose by 10 to 40”.
scenes.say: Common errors: the people increased — wrong; the number of people rose — right. More higher — wrong; much higher — right. And always say rose by how much or to what level.
scenes.say_uz: Odatiy xatolar: “the people increased” — xato; “the number of people rose” — to‘g‘ri. “More higher” — xato; “much higher” — to‘g‘ri. Va har doim “rose by” qanchaga yoki “rose to” qaysi darajaga ayting.

scenes.title: Taxmin va aniqlik: approximately, just over, precisely
board: just over / just under / well over / nearly / almost

examples.t: Approximately 40 % of respondents preferred online shopping.
examples.uz: Respondentlarning taxminan 40 foizi onlayn xaridni afzal ko‘rdi.

examples.t: Just over a third of the budget was spent on marketing.
examples.uz: Byudjetning uchdan biridan sal ko‘prog‘i marketingga sarflandi.

scenes.say_native: Grafikdagi raqamlar deyarli hech qachon mukammal aniq emas — shuning uchun taxmin so‘zlari majburiy. Umumiy taxmin: “approximately” — taxminan, “roughly” — qo‘pol aytganda, “about / around” — taxminan — “Approximately 40 % of respondents…” — taxminan 40 foiz. Chegara nuanslari: “just over” — sal ortiq — 33 % o‘rniga “just over a third”, “just under” — sal kam, “nearly / almost” — deyarli — 49 %, “well over” — ancha ortiq. Aniqlik: “precisely” va “exactly” — aynan — raqamlar jadvaldan olinsa — “precisely 12.4 %”. O‘quvchi qaysi aniqlik darajasini xohlayotganini kontekstdan anglaydi: hisobot — aniq, umumiy mulohaza — taxmin. Eslab qoling: taxmin va aniqni bir gapda aralashtirmang — “approximately exactly” — xato.
scenes.say: Approximation: approximately, roughly, about, around. Border nuances: just over, just under, nearly, almost, well over. Precision: precisely, exactly. Don’t mix both in one phrase.
scenes.say_uz: Taxmin: approximately, roughly, about, around. Chegara nuanslari: just over, just under, nearly, almost, well over. Aniqlik: precisely, exactly. Ikkalasini bir iborada aralashtirmang.

scenes.title: Taxmin ifodalari mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta raqamni taxmin iboralari bilan ayting. Birinchi: 33 foiz — “just over a third” yoki “approximately a third”. Ikkinchi: 49 foiz — “nearly half” yoki “just under 50 per cent”. Uchinchi: 78,3 foiz — aniq jadval raqami — “precisely 78.3 per cent”. Har bir gapni ingliz tilida to‘liq holda ayting — ifoda + raqam.
scenes.say: Say three figures with the right approximation: one, thirty-three per cent. Two, forty-nine per cent. Three, seventy-eight point three per cent. Use just over, nearly half, precisely.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta raqamni to‘g‘ri taxmin iborasi bilan ayting: bir, o‘ttiz uch foiz. Ikki, qirq to‘qqiz foiz. Uch, yetmishta sakkiz butun o‘n foiz. Just over, nearly half, precisely ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: taxmin mashqi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Just over a third of the budget — approximately 33 %” — uchdan biri. Ikkinchi: “Nearly half of the respondents — just under 50 %” — deyarli yarmi. Uchinchi: “Precisely 78.3 per cent of revenue came from services” — aniq son jadvaldan — “exactly” ham mumkin. Eslab qoling: IELTS baholovchisi taxmin iboralarini boy lug‘at sifatida baholaydi — bir xil so‘z ikkinchi marta kerak bo‘lsa, “roughly” ga o‘ting.
scenes.say: Answers: just over a third; nearly half, just under fifty per cent; precisely seventy-eight point three per cent. Rotate synonyms to show range.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: uchdan biridan sal ko‘prog‘i; deyarli yarmi, ellik foizdan sal kami; aniq yetmishta sakkiz butun o‘n foiz. So‘z boyligingizni ko‘rsatish uchun sinonimlarni almashtiring.

scenes.title: Doira grafik: ulushlar va nisbatlar
board: a quarter / a fifth / a third
the majority / the remainder / the rest

examples.t: A quarter of the budget went on rent.
examples.uz: Byudjetning to‘rtdan biri ijaraga ketdi.

examples.t: The majority — 58 % — chose online delivery.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik — 58 foiz — onlayn yetkazib berishni tanladi.

scenes.say_native: Doira grafik sinonimlar boyligi talab qiladi. Oddiy ulushlar: “a quarter” — to‘rtdan biri — 25 %, “a fifth” — beshdan biri — 20 %, “a third” — uchdan biri — 33 %, “half” — yarmi — 50 %. Katta ulushlar: “the majority” — ko‘pchilik — 50+ %, “the vast majority” — katta ko‘pchilik — 80+ %. Qolgan qism: “the remainder” yoki “the rest” — qolgani. Chetda: “just over / just under a third” — uchdan biridan sal ko‘p/kam — 32–34 %. Kichik ulushlar: “a small minority” — kichik ozchilik — 5–10 %. Eslab qoling: ulushni gapirganingizda insonning ulushi “of + noun” bilan keladi — “a quarter of the budget” — “a quarter budget” emas.
scenes.say: Pie chart language: a quarter, a fifth, a third, half; the majority, the vast majority; the remainder, the rest; a small minority. Always follow with of plus the noun.
scenes.say_uz: Doira grafik lug‘ati: a quarter, a fifth, a third, half; the majority, the vast majority; the remainder, the rest; a small minority. Har doim “of + ot” bilan davom eting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy tavsif: chiziqli grafik matni

examples.t: Overall, online sales grew steadily, peaking at 1.4 million in 2024.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, onlayn sotuvlar barqaror o‘sdi va 2024-yilda 1,4 million bilan cho‘qqiga chiqdi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy tavsifni o‘qing va tahlil qiling: “The line graph illustrates online sales from 2020 to 2024. Overall, online sales grew steadily, peaking at 1.4 million units in 2024. Sales stood at 0.6 million in 2020 and dipped marginally in 2022, after which growth accelerated. The most significant rise occurred between 2022 and 2024, when figures more than doubled.” Diqqat qiling: birinchi gap — grafik nima ko‘rsatadi; ikkinchi — overview; uchinchi — asosiy nuqtalar; to‘rtinchi — eng muhim trend. Sizning tavsiflaringiz ham xuddi shu skeletda bo‘ladi — 180–200 so‘z.
scenes.say: The line graph illustrates online sales from 2020 to 2024. Overall, sales grew steadily, peaking at 1.4 million units in 2024, more than doubling since 2022.
scenes.say_uz: Chiziqli grafik 2020–2024 yillar orasidagi onlayn sotuvlarni tasvirlaydi. Umuman olganda, sotuvlar barqaror o‘sdi va 2024-yilda 1,4 million dona bilan cho‘qqiga chiqdi, 2022-yildan beri ikki baravardan ham oshdi.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 1: menejer va tahlilchi grafik haqida
board: A: What does the chart show?
A: Which quarter was the worst?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — menejer va tahlilchi. A: “What does the chart show?” — grafik nimani ko‘rsatadi? B: “Retention fell from 78 % in January to 66 % in September. The fall was steepest in Q2, dropping 7 points.” — saqlanish yanvarda 78 foizdan sentyabrda 66 foizga tushdi. Pasayish eng tik Q2 da bo‘ldi — yetti ball. A: “And what about costs?” — xarajatlar-chi? B: “Costs remained stable at around 4.2 million per month. The problem is retention, not spend.” — xarajatlar oyiga taxminan 4,2 million rondida barqaror qoldi. Muammo saqlanishda, xarajatda emas. A: “Good. So why do you think retention fell?” — yaxshi. Nega saqlanish tushgan deb o‘ylaysiz? B: “Possibly the new onboarding flow — customers churn earlier.” — ehtimol yangi onboarding oqimi — mijozlar ertaroq ketib qolishadi. Diqqat qiling: grafikni o‘qish + sababni ehtiyotkorlik bilan taxmin qilish — “possibly” so‘zi.
scenes.say: What does the chart show? Retention fell from seventy-eight to sixty-six per cent. The fall was steepest in Q2. What about costs? Costs remained stable at around 4.2 million a month. Why do you think retention fell? Possibly the new onboarding flow.
scenes.say_uz: Grafik nimani ko‘rsatadi? Saqlanish yetmishta sakkiz foizdan oltmish olti foizga tushdi. Pasayish eng tik Q2 da bo‘ldi. Xarajatlar-chi? Xarajatlar oyiga taxminan 4,2 millionda barqaror qoldi. Nega tushgan deb o‘ylaysiz? Ehtimol yangi onboarding oqimi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: saqlanish qaysi raqamlardan qaysi raqamlargacha tushdi? Ikkinchi: pasayish eng tik qaysi chorakda bo‘ldi va necha ball? Uchinchi: xarajatlar qanday va qancha? To‘rtinchi: B sababni qanday ifoda bilan taxmin qildi — qaysi ehtiyotkor so‘z ishlatilgan? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida to‘liq gaplar bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: what were the retention figures, which quarter fell most and by how many points, what happened to costs, and which cautious word does B use for the cause?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: saqlanish raqamlari qanday bo‘ldi, qaysi chorak eng ko‘p tushdi va necha ballga, xarajatlar bilan nima bo‘ldi va B sabab uchun qaysi ehtiyotkor so‘zni ishlatadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Saqlanish: 78 foizdan 66 foizga — o‘n ikki ball pasayish. Eng tik pasayish: Q2 da — yetti ball. Xarajatlar: oyiga taxminan 4,2 million — barqaror. B “possibly” — ehtimol — so‘zini ishlatdi — dalilsiz ishonchdirmaslik — grafik sababni isbotlamaydi, faqat taxmin beradi. Shu — professional tahlilchining xulqi: “the data suggests” bilan taxmin qiling, “this proves” demang.
scenes.say: Answers: seventy-eight to sixty-six per cent; the steepest fall was in Q2, seven points; costs stayed flat at around 4.2 million monthly; B says possibly — data suggests, never proves.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: yetmishta sakkizdan oltmish olti foizgacha; eng tik pasayish Q2 da — yetti ball; xarajatlar oyiga taxminan 4,2 millionda barqaror qoldi; B “possibly” deydi — ma’lumot taxmin beradi, isbotlamaydi.

scenes.title: Xulosa chiqarish: the data suggests, it can be concluded

examples.t: The data suggests that demand peaks in summer.
examples.uz: Ma’lumotlar talabning yozda cho‘qqiga chiqishini bildiradi.

examples.t: It can be concluded that retention is the main risk.
examples.uz: Saqlanish asosiy xatar deb xulosa chiqarish mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Grafik tavsifning so‘nggi qadami — xulosa. Uchta xavfsiz tuzilma bor. Birinchisi: “The data suggests that…” — ma’lumotlar…ni bildiradi — eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan. Ikkinchisi: “It can be concluded that…” — …deb xulosa chiqarish mumkin — IELTS’da ball beradigan formal ifoda. Uchinchisi: ehtiyotkor modallar — “may”, “might”, “could” — mumkin — “The drop may be linked to the onboarding change” — pasayish onboarding o‘zgarishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin. Hech qachon “this proves” demang — grafik dalil beradi, isbotlamaydi. Xulosa ikki gapdan oshmasin — birinchisi asosiy topilma, ikkinchisi ehtiyotkor izoh.
scenes.say: Conclude with: the data suggests that, it can be concluded that, or cautious modals — may, might, could. Never claim the data proves; it only suggests.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosangizni shu tuzilmalar bilan bering: the data suggests that, it can be concluded that, yoki ehtiyotkor modallar — may, might, could. Hech qachon “ma’lumotlar isbotlaydi” demang; ular faqat ishora qiladi.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 2: ikki hamkasb xulosa ustida bahslashmoqda
board: A: So, sales are clearly failing.
B: Wait — is one quarter enough to conclude that?
A: Fair point. The data suggests a dip, not a trend.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — ikki hamkasb ma’lumot ustida bahslashmoqda. A: “So, sales are clearly failing — we need to cut the price” — demak, sotuvlar aniq qulayapti — narxni tushirishimiz kerak. B: “Wait — is one quarter enough to conclude that?” — bir soniya — bitta chorak shunga xulosa chiqarish uchun yetarlimi? A: “Fair point. The data suggests a dip, not a trend.” — to‘g‘ri nuqta. Ma’lumotlar pasayishni bildiradi, trendni emas. B: “Exactly. Let’s wait for Q3 before changing pricing.” — aynan. Narxni o‘zgartirishdan oldin Q3 ni kutaylik. A: “Right — I’ll present it as a short-term dip with a recommendation to monitor.” — to‘g‘ri — men buni qisqa muddatli pasayish sifatida ko‘rsataman, kuzatish tavsiyasi bilan. Diqqat qiling: ehtiyotkor xulosa kamroq dramatik, lekin ko‘proq professional.
scenes.say: So sales are clearly failing. Wait — is one quarter enough to conclude that? Fair point. The data suggests a dip, not a trend. Exactly. Let’s wait for Q3.
scenes.say_uz: Demak, sotuvlar aniq qulayapti. Biroz kuting — bitta chorak shunga xulosa chiqarish uchun yetarlimi? To‘g‘ri nuqta. Ma’lumotlar pasayishni bildiradi, trendni emas. Aynan. Q3 ni kutaylik.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: A dastlab nima dedi — qanday keskin xulosa? Ikkinchi: B qanday ehtiyotkor so‘roq berdi? Uchinchi: A suhbat davomida fikrini qanday o‘zgartirdi — qaysi iborani ishlatdi? To‘rtinchi: yakuniy qaror nima bo‘ldi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: what did A claim at first, what did B ask, how did A change the wording, and what was the final decision? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: A avvaliga nima dedi, B nimani so‘radi, A ifodasini qanday o‘zgartirdi va yakuniy qaror nima bo‘ldi? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A avval “sales are clearly failing” — keskin xulosa chiqardi. B “Is one quarter enough to conclude that?” — ehtiyotkor savol berdi. A “The data suggests a dip, not a trend” — bilan ifodasini tuzatdi. Yakuniy qaror: Q3 gacha narx o‘zgartirilmaydi, grafik qisqa muddatli pasayish sifatida taqdim etiladi. Mana — professional xulosa: dalil darajasidan oshmaydigan tanlangan so‘zlar.
scenes.say: Answers: A claimed sales were clearly failing; B asked if one quarter is enough; A corrected to a dip, not a trend; they decided to wait for Q3 and monitor.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: A sotuvlar aniq qulayapti dedi; B bitta chorak yetarli-yu yo‘qligini so‘radi; A “pasayish, trend emas” deb tuzatdi; ular Q3 ni kutishga va kuzatishga qaror qildi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: ikki grafikni yozma tasvirlash
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ikki grafik tasavvur qiling: biri chiziqli — 2020–2025 yillar orasidagi daromad — ikkinchisi doira — xarajatlar taqsimoti. Har biri uchun ingliz tilida to‘liq tavsif yozing: birinchi gap overview, keyin asosiy trend yoki ulushlar, solishtirish iboralari va xulosa. Ikkala matnida ham trend fe’llari, solishtirish tuzilmalari, taxmin iboralari va ehtiyotkor xulosa ishlatilsin. Keyin sinonimlaringizni tekshiring — bitta so‘z ikki marta takrorlanmasin.
scenes.say: Final task: write two short descriptions — line graph of revenue 2020 to 2025, and a pie chart of cost breakdown. Each needs an overview, key features, comparisons, and a cautious conclusion.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: ikkita qisqa tavsif yozing — 2020–2025 daromad chiziqli grafigi va xarajatlar taqsimoti doira grafigi. Har birida overview, asosiy xususiyatlar, solishtirishlar va ehtiyotkor xulosa bo‘lsin.

scenes.title: Namuna tavsif — barqaror struktura

examples.t: Revenue rose from 1.1 to 2.6 million, more than doubling over five years.
examples.uz: Daromad 1,1 milliondan 2,6 millionga oshdi — besh yil ichida ikki baravardan ham oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Namuna. “The line graph shows revenue from 2020 to 2025. Overall, revenue grew steadily, more than doubling over the period. It stood at 1.1 million in 2020 and rose sharply in 2023, reaching 2.6 million by 2025. The pie chart illustrates the cost breakdown: rent accounted for just over a third, salaries for a quarter, and marketing for roughly a fifth; the remainder went to operations. It can be concluded that growth outpaced costs, although marketing’s share edged higher year on year.” To‘rtta qatlam: overview, asosiy xususiyatlar, solishtirilgan tafsilotlar, xulosa. Sizning matningiz shu skeletga tayanadi.
scenes.say: Sample: overall, revenue grew steadily, more than doubling. Rent took just over a third, salaries a quarter, marketing roughly a fifth. It can be concluded that growth outpaced costs.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: umuman olganda, daromad barqaror o‘sdi va ikki baravardan oshdi. Ijara uchdan biridan ko‘prog‘ini, ish haqi to‘rtdan birini, marketing taxminan beshdan birini oldi. Xulosa: o‘sish xarajatlardan oldinga chiqdi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Trend fe’llari va ravishlari — rose, plummeted, plateaued; vaqt va zamon — from X to Y, present perfect with since; solishtirish — twice as high as, whereas, compared to; taxmin va aniqlik — just over, nearly, precisely; doira grafik ulushlari — a quarter, the majority; ehtiyotkor xulosa — the data suggests, it can be concluded. Endi IELTS Task 1 va ish prezentatsiyalari qiyin emas.
scenes.say: Today you learned trend vocabulary, comparisons, approximation and precision, pie chart language, and cautious conclusions — everything needed to describe charts confidently.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun trend lug‘ati, solishtirish, taxmin va aniqlik, doira grafik lug‘ati hamda ehtiyotkor xulosa chiqarishni o‘rgandingiz — grafikni ishonch bilan tasvirlash uchun kerakli hamma narsani.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Keyingi dars: Ommaviy nutq va notiqlik
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Internetdan yoki o‘z hisobotingizdan ikkita grafik tanlang — biri chiziqli, biri doira — va har birini 150-200 so‘zda ingliz tilida tasvirlab bering: overview, asosiy xususiyatlar, solishtirish, xulosa. Sinonimlaringizni tekshiring va “I think” ishlatmang. Keyingi darsda ommaviy nutq va notiqlikni o‘rganamiz — bugungi ma’lumotlarni til bilan yetkazish nutqning birinchi qadamidir. Goodbye!
scenes.say: Homework: describe two charts in writing — one line graph, one pie chart — each with an overview and a cautious conclusion. Next lesson: public speaking and oratory. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: ikki grafikni yozma tasvirlang — bitta chiziqli, bitta doira — har birida overview va ehtiyotkor xulosa bilan. Keyingi dars: ommaviy nutq va notiqlik. Xayr!

homework_uz: Ikki grafikni — bitta chiziqli, bitta doira grafigini — ingliz tilida 150–200 so‘zdan tasvirlab bering: overview, asosiy xususiyatlar, solishtirish va ehtiyotkor xulosa bilan. Keyingi dars: Ommaviy nutq va notiqlik.

quiz.why_uz: twice as high as — aniq ikki baravar solishtirish.

quiz.q: Grafik tavsifi qaysi gap bilan boshlanishi kerak?
“Just over a third” qaysi ulushga yaqin?
“Sales rose by 15 %” va “sales rose to 45 %” farqi?
quiz.why_uz: by + o‘zgarish miqdori, to + yakuniy daraja.

quiz.q: Grafik sababini qaysi so‘z bilan ehtiyotkor taxmin qilinadi?
“The data suggests that…” nega “this proves”dan yaxshiroq?
options: ma’lumot ishora qiladi, isbotlamaydi — akademik ehtiyotkorlik
quiz.why_uz: Grafik dalil beradi; xulosa doim ehtiyotkor bo‘ladi.
